description: Prepares an inquiry for one offer, for when the user has asked to inquire and given their email. voidjet emails the user a link; nothing is forwarded to the provider until the user opens it and sends the pre-filled form on voidjet.io within 48 hours. name, phone and message are optional, come from the user and only pre-fill the form. Prices are indicative.

flexible.description: True if the user is flexible on date and time.
flexible.title: Flexible

locale.description: Language of texts and links in the result: en or de.
locale.title: Locale

message.description: Message to the provider in the user's own words, optional.
message.title: Message

name.description: The user's name, only if the user gave it.
name.title: Name

phone.description: The user's phone number, only if the user gave it.
phone.title: Phone

ref.description: ref exactly as returned by search_empty_legs.
ref.title: Ref

name: request_inquiry
title: Prepare an inquiry
